Step: 1840-12-27 + 41 weeks = 1840-12-27 + 287 days = 1841-10-10 (since 1841 is not a leap year, careful month/day addition).  
41 weeks 4 days = 287 + 4 = 291 days.  
From 1840-12-27: 4 days left in Dec → 1840-12-31, then 291 - 4 = 287 days into 1841.  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30 → sum to 273 days by end of Sep.  
287 - 273 = 14 days into Oct → 1841-10-14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1841-10-14
